entities.summary: Aloys Thomas Raimund, Count von Harrach zu Rohrau was an Austrian nobleman, politician and a diplomat. Born in the late 17th century, he was a prominent figure in the Austrian court and played a key role in the country's foreign policy during the 18th century. Raimund's influence extended to the European continent, where he collaborated with other European leaders to shape the continent's diplomatic landscape. His diplomatic efforts contributed to the development of a more complex system of alliances and rivalries, which would have far-reaching consequences for European politics. As a key figure in the Austrian court, Raimund was also involved in the administration of the Austrian Empire's vast territories, which spanned across multiple continents. The impact of his work can still be seen today in the modern-day implications of his diplomatic efforts. Raimund's legacy is a testament to the enduring power of diplomacy in shaping the course of human history.
